title: समकालीन नेपाली कवितामा यथार्थवादी धारा
nepali: यो लेख नेपाली कविताको विकासप्रक्रियाको विश्लेषणसँग सम्बन्धित रहेको छ । नेपाली कविताको विकासप्रक्रियाका अध्ययनका सन्दर्भमा वि।सं। २०३६ को सडक कविताक्रान्तिपछिको समयावधिलाई समसामयिक युग नामकरण गरिएको पाइन्छ । कुनै एक प्रवृत्तिले स्थिरता प्राप्त गरिनसकेका अवधिमा कालिक सन्दर्भलाई आधार बनाई यस किसिमको नामकरण गर्नु सान्दर्भिक देखिए पनि निश्चत प्रवृत्तिको स्थिरीकरणसँगै कुनै वस्तुगत नाम दिनु वैज्ञानिक हुन्छ । यही सन्दर्भमा वि।सं। २०३६ भन्दा पछिको नेपाली कवितामा केकस्ता प्रवृत्तिहरू देखापरेका छन् र प्रवृत्तिगत दृष्टिले यस अवधिलाई के नाम दिनु उपयुक्त हुन्छ भन्ने मूल समस्यामा केन्द्रित रही यो लेख तयार पारिएको छ । यसका लागि यस लेखमा यस चरणका धेरै कविताहरूलाई प्राथमिक स्रोतका सामग्रीका रूपमा र नेपाली कविता तथा यसको समसामयिक युगका बारेमा गरिएका विश्लेषणहरूलाई द्वितीयक स्रोतका सामग्रीका रूपमा उपयोग गरिएको छ । गुणात्मक अनुसन्धानका ढाँचामा केन्द्रित रही तयार पारिएको यस लेखमा विशेष गरी सूक्ष्म पठन तथा विश्लेषण विधिको प्रयोग गरी निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । यस चरणका कविताहरू मूलतः वस्तुयथार्थका अभिव्यञ्जनामा केन्द्रित रहेका हुनाले प्रवृत्तिगत दृष्टिले यस अवधिलाई यथार्थवादी युग नामकरण गर्नु वैज्ञानिक हुने निष्कर्षलाई यस लेखले अगाडि सारेको छ । नेपाली कविताको पछिल्लो चरणलाई प्रवृत्तिगत दृष्टिले वैज्ञानिक रूपमा यथार्थवादी युग भनेर नामकरण गर्नु यस लेखको प्राप्ति तथा प्राज्ञिक योगदान रहेको छ ।
american_english: This paper is about the analysis of the development of Nepali poetry. In the context of studying the development of Nepali poetry, a period after the Sadraka Kavita revolution of 2036 BS was named the contemporary era. While it may have been relevant to name this kind based on a context in which no trend had yet stabilised, giving a specific term is scientific once a definite trend has stabilised. In that context, after 2036 BS, various trends have appeared in Nepali poetry, and from a trend-based perspective the main question of what to call that period is the one this paper was prepared around. For this, several poems of this phase were used as primary source material and the analyses of Nepali poetry and its contemporary era were used as secondary source material. Prepared while focusing on the framework of qualitative research, this study especially used close reading and analysis to draw conclusions. Since the poems of this phase were mainly based on realistic expression, the study concluded that naming this period the realistic era from a trend-based perspective was scientific, and the paper went ahead and presented that. It is the finding of this paper, and its scholarly contribution, to name the later phase of Nepali poetry the realistic era from a trend-based perspective.
british_english: This paper concerns the analysis of the development of Nepali poetry. In the context of studying the development of Nepali poetry, a period following the Sadraka Kavita revolution of 2036 BS came to be known as the contemporary era. Although it might have been pertinent to assign a name to this category on the basis of a context in which no trend had attained stability, once a definite trend has stabilised, assigning a specific term is a scientific matter. In that context, after 2036 BS, various trends have been observed in Nepali poetry, and from a trend-based perspective the main question of what to call that period is what this paper was prepared to address. For that purpose, several poems from this phase were used as primary source material and the analyses of Nepali poetry and its contemporary era as secondary source material. Centred on the framework of qualitative research, this study made use of close reading and analysis, especially, to draw conclusions. Since the poems of this phase were essentially based on realistic expression, the study concluded that naming this period the realistic era from a trend-based perspective was a scientific exercise, and the paper went on to present it. It was as the finding and academic contribution of this paper that the later phase of Nepali poetry was named the realistic era from a trend-based perspective.
